relations.note: Libertas was joined with Jupiter in a disputed cult title and Aventine temple association.
relations.source: Fasti Antiates; Res Gestae 19; CIL XI 657

relations.note: A flying Victory crowns the chariot-driving Libertas on a republican denarius.
Libertas and Roma appear within the same republican coin issues and political visual programs.
The Senate reportedly titled Caesar Liberator and voted a public temple of Liberty.
Later commentary connected Liber’s name and symbolism with libertas, without identifying the deities.
Feronia and Libertas shared associations with manumission; Ripa later borrowed Feronian imagery for Liberty.
Public Libertas received a monumental dedication alongside perpetual Augustan Salus.
